Required of anyone 15 or older to hunt any game bird or mammal on public or private land. Valid from purchase through 30 June. Includes the Wildlife Conservation Stamp for game mammal hunting.

Also includes the Wildlife Conservation Stamp. First-time nonresidents must first obtain a Letter of Exemption, free with an out-of-state hunter education card or a Hawaii licence issued before 1 July 1990.
Bought on top of the Fishing/Hunting/Furbearer Certificate and the General Game and Habitat License.
Nonlottery purchase path. PLOTS and WMA first-week pheasant restrictions apply.
PREREQUISITE. Required to hunt or fish in ND except spring light goose and early Canada goose. One per licensee per year.
PREREQUISITE. Required for all hunting licences except furbearer, nongame, spring light goose and early Canada goose. One per licensee per year.
Bundles the certificate, general game and habitat licence and small game/fishing privileges.
Landowner gratis licence. Gratis holders need only the gratis licence - no certificate or habitat licence required.
For those 12 and older who have not taken hunter education; allows small game (incl. waterfowl) and deer for one licence year, renewable once.
Zone-restricted, sold as two 7-day periods.
Nonresidents hunting only unprotected species need only this licence.
Exempt from the General Game and Habitat License requirement.
Covers upland game birds, rabbits, squirrels, doves, other webless migratory birds and waterfowl. Requires a Habitat Stamp; waterfowl needs a second stamp. 3-year and 5-year versions sold.
3-year and 5-year versions also sold.
Short-term small game option.
Priced at the resident annual rate.
Combo hunt permits do NOT include big game or turkey. Habitat stamps are included in certain combo and multi-year small game permits.
A $3 agent issuing fee is included in all permits except the Lifetime Habitat and Migratory Waterfowl Stamps.
Includes the $300 Lifetime Aquatic Habitat Stamp.
Holders are exempt from the Habitat Stamp for antelope, deer and turkey; the permit must be carried while hunting.
Exempt from the Habitat Stamp for antelope, deer and turkey.
Resident and nonresident versions sold at different rates.

Base licence. Must be paired with the Habitat Management & Access Validation and, for federal public land, the Habitat Stamp. Licence year 1 April - 31 March. Fees rose 1 April 2026 under Senate Bill 5, the first increase in over 20 years.
Also requires HMAV and Habitat Stamp. Nonresidents may buy over-the-counter licences for bear, cougar, turkey, javelina, Barbary sheep, ibex and private-land deer without entering the draw.
Combined hunting and fishing licence.
Reduced fee, age 17 and younger at time of purchase. Resident and nonresident versions.
Reduced-fee junior combination.
Reduced fee for qualifying resident seniors; residents 70 and older receive a free game hunting licence.
Reduced fee for NM residents with a permanent disability under the ADA. Holders must still buy the Habitat Stamp and HMAV.

license_class_name: Disabled Veteran Game-Hunting and Fishing License
notes: Reduced fee. Resident veterans with 100 percent service-connected disability may qualify for a free lifetime licence.
Nonresident only, four consecutive days. Duration recorded as the nearest controlled value; the product is a 4-day licence.
Reduced-fee junior trapping licence.
Age 18 and older. Valid 365 days from purchase rather than by calendar year.
Hunting-only resident licence. Big game requires a separate draw tag; a licence alone does not confer big game privileges.
Ages 12-17, same fee for residents and nonresidents.
The standard nonresident option; there is no separate nonresident hunting-only licence.
Age 12 and older for those still completing hunter education. Sold only at NDOW offices.
Residents 65 and older with at least six months residency.

license_class_name: Resident Native American Specialty Combination License
notes: Established under NRS 502.280, which also sets big game tag requirements and tribal consultation provisions.
Under NRS 502.290, for Nevada residents in the armed forces not stationed in Nevada.
Free to residents of six months or more certified by the VA at 50 percent or more service-connected disability.
Base hunting credential: pheasant, grouse, partridge, quail, cottontail and tree squirrel, plus predator/varmint species. Requires a Habitat Stamp for anyone 18 or older.
Nonresident pheasant licences are not numerically capped but are priced above resident rates.
No Habitat Stamp required, and exempt from the $6 legislative surcharge.
Age 19 or over. Fishing plus small game. Does NOT include the State Migratory Bird Certificate or furbearer/trapping privileges.

Residents aged 16 to 18 must buy this rather than the standard combination.
No Habitat Stamp required and exempt from the $6 surcharge.
Landowners are exempt from the Habitat Stamp when hunting their own land.
No Habitat Stamp required. Resident veterans qualify via a 40 percent or greater service-connected disability allotment or a VA 'K' Award.
Coyote, fox, skunk, raccoon, badger, prairie dog, ground squirrel, crow, jackrabbit, porcupine and marmot. Exempt from the $6 surcharge.
Trapping privileges; exempt from the $6 legislative surcharge.
